clue.text: Records white space replaced by square

indicators.note: one piece is swapped out and the next piece put where it stood, so a substitution is signalled

parts.note: albumen is the white of an egg
an en is a printer's space, half an em

explanation.surface: Some printed records have had their blank white area swapped for a square box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'White' is a noun here: the white of an egg. An en is a printing measure of space.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: LP records are also called albums, collections of tracks issued together.

clue.text: Records Central Park herbs

indicators.note: the central letters of a word are those left once its ends are dropped, here taken from the word Park

parts.note: chives are an onion-flavoured herb

explanation.surface: Documents about the herbs growing in New York's Central Park.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Central Park' looks like the New York landmark, but 'Central' picks the middle of 'Park'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: archives are collections of historical documents and records.

clue.text: Notice herb in good French game

indicators.note: one pair of pieces sits within the other, so 'in' signals an insertion

parts.note: bon is French for good
an ad, an advertisement, is a notice
mint is a common herb

explanation.surface: A notice about some herb inside a good French game.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: badminton is a racket game played with a shuttlecock.

clue.text: Actor Herbert turns up with unknown but fabulous herb

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read from bottom to top, i.e. backwards

parts.note: Herbert Lom was a Czech-born British film actor, known from the Pink Panther films
y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: An actor named Herbert arrives carrying a mysterious, legendary herb.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'turns up' reverses LOM to MOL.
explanation.definitionFit: Myth: in the Odyssey Hermes gives Odysseus this magic plant to protect him from Circe's spells.

clue.text: Herb I see beside American church

parts.note: basil is a culinary herb
the letter C is pronounced like the word see

explanation.surface: A man called Herb says he can see a church beside the American one.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a basilica is a large church given special ceremonial rights by the Pope.

clue.text: Soften cooked sausage

indicators.note: cooked suggests something altered or doctored, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cooking a sausage makes it softer.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to assuage pain or grief is to ease or soften it.

clue.text: Difficult to understand nice throne being remodelled

indicators.note: something remodelled is reshaped, so the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A nice throne is being remodelled in a way that is hard to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: incoherent speech or writing is muddled and hard to make sense of.

clue.text: Angry one on speed

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
rate is speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: Someone is cross after taking amphetamines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Speed' reads as the drug in the surface; here it is a rate of movement. In a down entry, 'on' puts I above RATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone irate is very angry.

clue.text: Nearly nothing in charity chest in the end

indicators.note: one piece sits within another, so the first 'in' signals an insertion

parts.note: alms are charitable gifts to the poor
O looks like zero, nothing

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter, here from the word chest

explanation.surface: In the end, there was almost nothing in the charity's chest.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: almost and nearly both mean not quite.

clue.text: Herb's chromosome indicator

parts.note: Y is the male sex chromosome
an arrow is a sign pointing the way

explanation.surface: A herb's indicator of chromosome, as if plants carried a gene marker.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', joining definition to wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: yarrow is a feathery-leaved herb, Achillea millefolium.

clue.text: Luxury cars about to get active control system containing herb

indicators.note: the first pieces hold another inside them, so 'containing' signals an insertion

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means about
ACS is the abbreviation for an active control system
dill is a feathery herb

explanation.surface: Luxury cars about to be fitted with an active control system with a herb inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Cadillac is an American make of luxury car.

clue.text: About to impair ornament

parts.note: c, short for circa, means about
to harm is to damage or impair

explanation.surface: Someone is on the point of spoiling a decoration.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a charm is a small trinket worn as an ornament on a bracelet.

clue.text: Goddess, one rejecting title

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: rejecting suggests throwing back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: Sir is a title given to a knight

explanation.surface: A goddess turns down a knighthood.
explanation.definitionFit: Myth: Iris was the Greek goddess of the rainbow and a messenger of the gods.

clue.text: Steals herb mixture when short- winded

indicators.note: a mixture blends things together, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone out of breath pinches a blend of herbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: breathless and short-winded both describe panting for air.

clue.text: Display herb for European publicist

indicators.note: 'herb for European' puts one piece in place of another, a substitution

parts.note: to present is to display or show
sage is a grey-leaved herb

explanation.surface: A publicist showing off a herb in place of a European one.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a press agent handles publicity for a client, a publicist.

clue.text: To humiliate himself wore cat out

indicators.note: out suggests something put out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man humbles himself by wearing a cat costume.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to eat crow is to admit a mistake and accept humiliation.

clue.text: Wandering bulldozer ran through walls

indicators.note: the outer words wall in, enclosing, the letters wanted between them

explanation.surface: A bulldozer charged right through some walls.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: errant means straying or wandering, like a knight errant.

clue.text: Alan let on about the number of apples in an empty barrel

definitions.text: the number of apples in an empty barrel

indicators.note: about suggests moving things around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Alan revealed how many apples are left in the empty barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Logic: an empty barrel holds zero apples, which is the phrase meaning not a single one.

clue.text: Yorkshire town soak like Rosemary?

parts.note: to wet is to soak
rosemary is a herb, so something like it is herby

explanation.surface: A Yorkshire town drenches someone named Rosemary.
explanation.walkthrough: Rosemary is capitalised to look like a woman's name; it is the herb. Wetherby is a market town in West Yorkshire, England, known for its racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Wetherby is a market town in West Yorkshire, England.

clue.text: Drinks a concoction including some cuttlefish

indicators.note: the words include the letters wanted inside them

explanation.surface: A mixed drink with bits of cuttlefish in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Part for whole: the organ that squirts ink is a part of a cuttlefish.

clue.text: Boring work interrupted by extremely tuneful laugh

indicators.note: something interrupted has another thing break into it, so a piece goes inside

parts.note: a chore is a tedious, boring task

indicators.note: the extremes of a word are its first and last letters, here of tuneful

explanation.surface: Dull work broken up by a very musical laugh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' looks like 'very' but picks the ends T and L of 'tuneful'.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a chortle is a gleeful chuckling laugh, a word coined by Lewis Carroll.

clue.text: Act of contrition by last character to leave coastal town

indicators.note: a letter leaving a word is taken out of it

parts.note: Penzance is a coastal town in Cornwall, south-west England
Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone repents by making the final person leave a seaside town.
explanation.walkthrough: Penzance is a seaside town in Cornwall, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: penance is an act done to show sorrow for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Asians with empty accounts under pressure

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece under another is placed below it

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure
and means with, together

indicators.note: an emptied word loses its inside, leaving its first and last letters, here of accounts

explanation.surface: Asian people whose bank balances are empty and who are under strain.
explanation.definitionFit: Category: giant and red pandas are animals native to Asia.

clue.text: Herb trumpeting prelate not fully organised

indicators.note: organised means put in order, so the letters are rearranged
a word not fully given loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A man named Herb is blowing a trumpet for a disorganised prelate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Herb' is not a plant here: Herb Alpert is an American trumpeter, leader of the Tijuana Brass. 'Not fully' drops the final E, leaving PRELAT.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Herb Alpert is the trumpeter famous for 'A Taste of Honey'.

clue.text: Storm heading off to stop solitary heroine

indicators.note: a stopper goes into an opening, so this piece is put inside the other

parts.note: lone means solitary

indicators.note: a word with its heading off loses its first letter

parts.note: a tornado is a violent storm

explanation.surface: A storm heads off to halt a lonely heroine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heading off' drops T from TORNADO, leaving ORNADO.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Lorna Doone is the heroine of R. D. Blackmore's 1869 novel set on Exmoor.

clue.text: Army unit adopts unfashionable course

indicators.note: to adopt is to take in, so one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
out means unfashionable, as in out of fashion

explanation.surface: A military unit takes up an unfashionable course of action.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a route is a course or way taken.

clue.text: Shampoo used to be hot

parts.note: was means used to be
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: The shampoo that was once hot.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a shampoo is a wash, especially of the hair.

clue.text: Female head of state demoted

parts.note: the leading female of a group is the alpha female; demote her and she drops to the second grade, named by the Greek letter after alpha

explanation.surface: A queen or president has been knocked down a rank.
explanation.walkthrough: The blogger could not see a parse; this reading takes the leading female as the alpha, so demoting her gives the second Greek letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ranking: in Greek-letter grading the second grade follows alpha, so a demoted top-ranker becomes second.

clue.text: Avoid Spanish article due for revision

parts.note: el is the Spanish for the

indicators.note: revising something changes it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Skipping a Spanish essay that needs to be revised.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to elude is to evade or avoid.

clue.text: Farted about with gas mixture at expo

indicators.note: about suggests moving round, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: air is a mixture of gases, chiefly nitrogen and oxygen

explanation.surface: Someone broke wind and fooled about with a mix of gases at an exhibition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an expo, exposition, is a commercial exhibition where firms show their goods.

clue.text: Scores left in knots

indicators.note: one piece sits inside another, so 'in' signals an insertion

parts.note: ties are knots, as in tying a bow
went means left, departed

explanation.surface: Scores were left tied up in knots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left' is the verb, departed, not the side.
explanation.definitionFit: Number: a score is twenty, so scores are several twenties.

clue.text: Section missing from herb discussion

indicators.note: a piece missing from a word is taken out of it

parts.note: parsley is a common garnish herb

explanation.surface: A section of a discussion about herbs has gone missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a parley is a discussion, especially between enemies about terms.
